newsitem.title: USA: Owens Corning sees Q3 shr $1.35-$1.45.
newsitem.headline: Owens Corning sees Q3 shr $1.35-$1.45.

text.p: Owens Corning Chief Executive Officer Glen Hiner said on Wednesday he expected the company's diluted earnings per share to be between $1.35 and $1.45 for the third quarter of the year.
Hiner was at a press conference for the company's new System Thinking program. The program aims to change the way homeowners think about home maintenance and improvements.
Chief Financial Officer David Devonshire said the company's diluted earnings per share for last year's third quarter were $1.28.
The company has estimated that its diluted earnings per share for 1996 will be between $4.65 and $4.75, excluding charges.
